newsitem.title: INDIA: Barclays Bank reduces Indian prime lending rate.
newsitem.headline: Barclays Bank reduces Indian prime lending rate.

text.p: Barclays Bank Plc is reducing its Indian prime lending rate to 17.5 percent per annum from 18.5 percent effective November 1, an official of the Bombay office told Reuters on Wednesday.
He said the bank's maximum spread over prime rate would be 4.0 percent.

The bank's decision is in line with that of most other banks which have reduced their lending rates after the October 19 monetary policy statement of the Reserve Bank of India, which boosted liquidity and prompted interest rate cuts.
